chunks: And by his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
When I die, animosities will appear to you in the hearts of some people who will unite against you to prevent you from getting your right.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the hidden animosities that would arise after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the prophetic foretelling of political and spiritual opposition Ali (a.s.) would face post-Ghadir, specifically referencing the 'Ghassaniyya' or Umayyad faction who sought to usurp his caliphate. The term 'Daghā'in' (hidden animosities) underscores the internalization of this enmity, which Shia scholarship often links to the historical context of the Saqifa event and the subsequent consolidation of power by the Umayyads against the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-304 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), the Prophet (S) said,
“(O Ali!) Once I die, the animosities hidden in the hearts of some people will show up and they will unite together against you and prevent you from getting what is rightfully yours.”
